text: 当我们谈及为何40岁男性普遍不考虑40岁女性时，首先要明确的是，这并非一个绝对的普遍现象，而是基于一些社会现象和心理因素的综合体现。
en: When we talk about why men in their forties generally do not consider women in their forties, the first thing to clarify is that this is not an absolute or universal phenomenon, but rather a composite reflection of certain social phenomena and psychological factors.

text: 然而，从相亲平台的观察来看，确实存在这样的趋势，那么背后究竟隐藏着怎样的原因呢？
en: However, observations from matchmaking platforms do show such a trend, so what exactly lies behind it?

text: 首先，我们要认识到年龄对于男女双方而言，在择偶时往往扮演着不同的角色。
en: First, we must recognise that age often plays a different role for men and women when choosing a partner.

text: 在传统观念中，男性往往被期望在事业和经济上有所成就，而女性则更多地被期待在年龄上保持一定的优势。
en: In traditional thinking, men are often expected to achieve something in their careers and finances, while women are more expected to maintain a certain advantage in terms of age.

text: 这种观念虽然在现代社会有所淡化，但仍然在潜意识中影响着人们的择偶观。
en: Although this notion has faded somewhat in modern society, it still subconsciously influences people's views on choosing a partner.

text: 你看呀，像杨振宁 82 岁还能娶 28 岁的翁帆，范曾 86 岁能娶 36 岁的艾尚真，高亚麟 52 岁呢，他的情人徐梓钧才 26 岁。
en: Look, for instance, Zhenning Yang married Fan Weng when he was 82 and she was 28; Zeng Fan married Shangzhen Ai at 86 when she was 36; and Yalin Gao, at 52, had his lover Zijun Xu, who was only 26.

text: 这说明了啥呀？
en: What does this show?

text: 这说明在一些男人眼里呀，年龄根本不是问题呀，只要他们活得好，又有钱，那找个年轻得多的女朋友甚至都有可能还在读小学呢！
en: This shows that in the eyes of some men, age is simply not an issue; as long as they live well and have money, they could even find a much younger girlfriend who might still be in primary school!

text: 不禁会感叹岁月的无情和爱情的伟大，然而，这些案例也反映出一种社会现象：只要男性活得好，又有钱，他们在择偶时往往拥有更多的选择权。
en: One cannot help but marvel at the ruthlessness of time and the greatness of love; however, these cases also reflect a social phenomenon: as long as men live well and have money, they tend to have more choice when selecting a partner.

text: 他们可以跨越年龄的鸿沟，追求自己心仪的年轻伴侣。
en: They can cross the chasm of age and pursue the young partner they admire.

text: 而对于女性来说，随着年龄的增长，她们的择偶范围可能会逐渐缩小，面临的竞争压力也会增加。
en: For women, as they grow older, their pool of potential partners may gradually shrink, and the competitive pressure they face also increases.

text: 接下来，让我们深入探讨一下为什么40岁男性普遍不考虑40岁女性。
en: Next, let us explore in depth why men in their forties generally do not consider women in their forties.

text: 一、生育能力的考虑
en: I. Consideration of fertility

text: 在生物学上，女性的生育能力随着年龄的增长而逐渐下降。
en: Biologically, a woman's fertility gradually declines with age.

text: 相比之下，男性的生育能力则相对持久。
en: By contrast, a man's fertility is relatively enduring.

text: 因此，在择偶时，男性可能会更加关注女性的生育能力，尤其是当他们自身条件优越、事业有成时，更希望能够与一位年轻、具有生育能力的女性携手共度未来。
en: Therefore, when choosing a partner, men may pay more attention to a woman's fertility, and especially when they themselves are privileged and successful in their careers, they hope all the more to join hands with a young, fertile woman to spend the future together.

text: 而40岁女性在这方面可能已经不占优势，从而降低了她们在男性眼中的吸引力。
en: A woman in her forties may no longer have an advantage in this regard, thus reducing her appeal in the eyes of men.

text: 二、心理层面的需求
en: II. Psychological needs

text: 除了生育能力外，男性在择偶时还可能受到心理层面的影响。
en: Apart from fertility, men may also be influenced at the psychological level when choosing a partner.

text: 年轻女性通常具有更加充沛的精力和活力，能够更好地满足男性在生理和心理上的需求。
en: Younger women usually have more abundant energy and vitality, and can better satisfy men's physical and psychological needs.

text: 相比之下，40岁女性可能在经历过人生的种种起伏后，变得更加成熟稳重，但同时也可能缺乏一些年轻女性的活力和激情。
en: By contrast, a woman in her forties, having experienced the various ups and downs of life, may become more mature and steady, but may also lack some of the vitality and passion of younger women.

text: 这种差异可能导致男性在择偶时更倾向于选择年轻女性。
en: This difference may lead men to favour younger women when choosing a partner.

text: 三、社会压力和传统观念的影响
en: III. The influence of social pressure and traditional thinking

text: 尽管现代社会对于年龄和婚姻的观念已经越来越开放和包容，但传统观念仍然在一定程度上影响着人们的择偶观。
en: Although modern society's views on age and marriage have become increasingly open and tolerant, traditional thinking still influences people's choice of partner to a certain extent.

text: 在一些人看来，男性应该娶比自己年轻的女性，这既是一种身份的象征，也是一种社会地位的体现。
en: In the eyes of some, a man should marry a woman younger than himself; this is both a symbol of status and an expression of social standing.

text: 而女性则应该与年龄相仿或稍大的男性结婚，以寻求更多的稳定感和安全感。
en: Women, for their part, should marry a man of similar or slightly older age, so as to seek greater stability and a sense of security.

text: 这种观念在潜意识中影响着人们的择偶选择，使得40岁男性普遍不考虑40岁女性。
en: This notion subconsciously influences people's mating choices, causing men in their forties generally not to consider women in their forties.

text: 四、个人经历和喜好
en: IV. Personal experience and preferences

text: 当然，每个人的经历和喜好都是不同的。
en: Of course, everyone's experiences and preferences are different.

text: 有些男性可能更加看重女性的内在品质、智慧和成熟度，而不是仅仅关注年龄和外貌。
en: Some men may value a woman's inner qualities, wisdom and maturity more, rather than focusing merely on age and appearance.

text: 然而，在相亲平台上，由于双方缺乏深入了解的机会，男性往往只能通过年龄、外貌等外在条件来初步判断对方是否合适。
en: However, on matchmaking platforms, because the two sides lack the chance for deep understanding, men can often only make a preliminary judgement about whether the other person is suitable based on external conditions such as age and appearance.

text: 在这种情况下，年龄的差异可能成为一个重要的考量因素。
en: In such circumstances, the age gap may become an important consideration.

text: 在当下社会，大龄剩女现象愈发引人关注。
en: In today's society, the phenomenon of older leftover women is drawing increasing attention.

text: 然而，这并不意味着我们需要深入探讨其背后的原因。
en: However, this does not mean we need to explore the reasons behind it in depth.

text: 每个人都有自己的生活轨迹和选择，我们应当尊重并理解她们的决定。
en: Everyone has their own life path and choices, and we should respect and understand their decisions.

text: 在这篇文章中，我们将不深入探讨大龄剩女的原因，而是从更宽泛的角度来谈谈她们的生活状态和价值观。
en: In this article, we will not explore the reasons for older leftover women, but will instead talk about their life circumstances and values from a broader perspective.

text: 首先，我们要明确的是，大龄剩女并不意味着她们在生活、事业或感情上有所欠缺。
en: First, what we must make clear is that being an older leftover woman does not mean they are deficient in life, career or relationships.

text: 相反，她们可能拥有丰富的人生经历、独立的经济能力和独特的个性魅力。
en: On the contrary, they may possess rich life experience, independent financial capability and a unique personal charm.

text: 她们选择单身，或许是因为她们更享受一个人的自由，或许是因为她们在等待那个对的人出现，也或许是因为她们对婚姻持有不同的看法。
en: They choose to be single, perhaps because they enjoy the freedom of being alone more, perhaps because they are waiting for the right person to appear, or perhaps because they hold a different view on marriage.

text: 这些选择都应当得到尊重，而不是被贴上“剩女”的标签。
en: These choices should all be respected, rather than being labelled with the 'leftover woman' tag.

text: 此外，大龄剩女们往往拥有更加独立和自主的生活方式。
en: In addition, older leftover women often possess a more independent and autonomous lifestyle.

text: 她们可能热爱旅行、追求艺术、关注社会热点，或者投身公益事业。
en: They may love to travel, pursue the arts, follow social hotspots, or devote themselves to public welfare.

text: 她们的生活充满了多样性和活力，她们用自己的方式诠释着生活的美好。
en: Their lives are full of diversity and vitality; they interpret the beauty of life in their own way.

text: 这些经历和感悟让她们更加成熟、自信和有魅力，使她们在人群中脱颖而出。
en: These experiences and insights make them more mature, confident and charming, allowing them to stand out from the crowd.

text: 当然，我们也不能忽视社会对大龄剩女的偏见和压力。
en: Of course, we cannot ignore the prejudice and pressure that society places on older leftover women.

text: 在一些传统观念中，女性到了适婚年龄就应该结婚生子，否则就会被视为异类。
en: In some traditional thinking, women should marry and have children once they reach marriageable age, otherwise they are seen as an anomaly.

text: 然而，这种观念已经逐渐被打破，越来越多的人开始认识到，每个人都有权利选择自己的生活方式，无论是否结婚。
en: However, this notion has gradually been broken down, and more and more people are coming to realise that everyone has the right to choose their own way of life, regardless of whether they marry.

text: 我们应该努力营造一个包容、平等的社会氛围，让每个人都能够自由地追求自己的梦想和幸福。
en: We should strive to create an inclusive and equal social atmosphere, so that everyone can freely pursue their dreams and happiness.

text: 最后，我们要说的是，大龄剩女并不是一个问题，而是一个现象。
en: Finally, what we want to say is that older leftover women are not a problem, but a phenomenon.

text: 它反映了现代女性独立、自主的生活态度和价值观。
en: It reflects the independent and autonomous attitude to life and values of modern women.

text: 我们应当以开放、包容的心态看待这一现象，尊重每个人的选择和权利。
en: We should view this phenomenon with an open and tolerant mindset, and respect everyone's choices and rights.

text: 同时，我们也应该鼓励女性勇敢地追求自己的梦想和幸福，不要被传统观念所束缚，活出自己的精彩人生。
en: At the same time, we should also encourage women to bravely pursue their dreams and happiness, not to be bound by traditional thinking, and to live a brilliant life of their own.

text: 在这个多元化的社会中，每个人都有权利选择自己的生活方式。
en: In this diverse society, everyone has the right to choose their own way of life.

text: 大龄剩女们选择了单身，但这并不意味着她们的生活就缺乏色彩和意义。
en: Older leftover women have chosen to be single, but this does not mean their lives lack colour and meaning.

text: 相反，她们通过自己的努力和追求，让生活变得更加充实和精彩。
en: On the contrary, through their own efforts and pursuits, they make their lives fuller and more brilliant.

text: 她们可能专注于事业发展，成为职场上的佼佼者；也可能投身公益事业，为社会贡献自己的力量；还可能追求个人兴趣爱好，丰富自己的精神世界。
en: They may focus on their career development and become outstanding performers in the workplace; they may also devote themselves to public welfare, contributing their strength to society; or they may pursue personal hobbies and interests, enriching their spiritual world.

text: 这些经历和成就让她们的生活更加丰富多彩，也让她们成为了社会不可或缺的一部分。
en: These experiences and achievements make their lives richer and more colourful, and also make them an indispensable part of society.

text: 因此，我们不应该将大龄剩女视为一个需要解决的问题，而应该将其视为一个值得尊重和欣赏的群体。
en: Therefore, we should not regard older leftover women as a problem that needs solving, but should view them as a group worthy of respect and admiration.

text: 我们应该摒弃对她们的偏见和歧视，给予她们足够的支持和鼓励。
en: We should discard our prejudice and discrimination against them, and give them sufficient support and encouragement.

text: 同时，我们也应该倡导更加开放、包容的社会氛围，让每个人都能够自由地选择自己的生活方式，追求自己的梦想和幸福。
en: At the same time, we should also advocate a more open and tolerant social atmosphere, so that everyone can freely choose their own way of life and pursue their dreams and happiness.

text: 总之，大龄剩女并不是一个问题，而是一个多元化的社会现象。
en: In short, older leftover women are not a problem, but a diverse social phenomenon.

text: 我们应该以开放、包容的心态看待这一现象，尊重每个人的选择和权利。
en: We should view this phenomenon with an open and tolerant mindset, and respect everyone's choices and rights.

text: 让我们共同努力，营造一个更加美好、和谐的社会环境，让每个人都能够活出自己的精彩人生。
en: Let us work together to create a more beautiful and harmonious social environment, so that everyone can live a brilliant life of their own.
